entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... yes. I think I need to return something? I'm just not sure... the website was a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your full name and order number?
Sure, it's Sarah Jenkins. Order number... uhm... 7-8-6-2-2-5-1.
Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?

Well, I bought them a while ago. I finally put the cleats on and went for a ride, but they just hurt so much. I got terrible blisters on my heels. I don't know what I'm supposed to do. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing you blisters, Sarah. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility on your order. One moment.
Okay, I've reviewed your account. I can see the cycling shoes were delivered 83 days ago. According to our policy, standard items can be returned within 90 days.
Oh! So... I can still return them? I can get a refund? I was so worried I was too late.

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the return window. I can start that process for you right now and email you a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the shoes, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that is such a relief. Thank you so much, David! You've made this so easy.
You are very welcome, Sarah. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
